note:
The three surfaces that draw `ProxyTag`, which must draw the SAME one: the decklist row, the commander caption on the deck head, and the review row. Its own inventory rather than a section of `proxies.json`, because `check:shared` asks the `shares` block of every row in its file — and that file also photographs the list route and the `/decks` tile, neither of which draws a mark. The deck head is a separate row from the decklist even though one `goto` reaches both: the caption is in a `<header>` outside `<main>`, and a shot scrolled to the rows does not show it. `spine-mobile.tsx` gets its OWN row: `check:shared` reads each row's `view` directly, so with the desktop spine alone a phone-only regression would leave the gate green while the mobile caption stopped using the shared mark — the same reason `commander-image.json` carries both spines. And the review row needs `PROXY_REVIEW_DECK`: a versioned deck whose DRAFT holds a printed add, because `admitsReview` redirects a deck with no pending changes and the cell would photograph a redirect. CORRECTED 2026-09-15 — this paragraph said `deck-card-tile.tsx` was a fifth renderer of the mark that this file does not check, because reaching the card view needed a click on a toggle that "resolves then times out". MEASURED: it does not time out. `card-captions.json` presses the same toggle by the same accessible name and reached all four of its cells, and `probe:card-captions` clicks it too. What actually defeats a run on these routes is the About gate (#658), which redirects a reader below `ABOUT_VERSION` and lets the cell count as reached while photographing the About page — see that file's note. That row is BUILT now — `deck-card-view` below — so the mark's fifth renderer is photographed rather than left to `deck-card-tile.test.tsx` alone. Its waits name the toggle and then the caption, and the press has a readiness check after it rather than a bare `settle` — a toggle that no-ops otherwise photographs the list and counts as a reached card view.

EVERY OTHER ROW's wait was `h1`, or `main, [role=main], h1` whose first clause matches the shell instantly. Both routes here ship a `loading.tsx` drawing `LoadingScreen`, whose `<h1>` sits inside `<main>` — so each of those resolved against the skeleton the runner's own docblock says it must not photograph, with only `settle` between the wait and the shutter. **They are UNFIXED, deliberately, and this is the follow-up.** `h1:not([role=status] h1)` — `LoadingScreen`'s container carries `role="status"` — passes all four at desktop and FAILS all four at the phone, which is the measurement that matters: at phone width these routes put their title in `MobileHeader`, outside `<main>`, so there is no route `h1` under the runner's scope and the only match the old wait ever had was the skeleton's. Those four phone cells have been waiting on the loading screen and photographing whatever `settle` happened to land on.

Fixing it needs a verified content selector per route at phone width, which is more than the change that found it should carry — a guessed selector here breaks a row belonging to another feature. The original waits stand until then; they are no worse than they were, and now they are written down.

PRECONDITION for every row here: `PROXY_DECK` must be a deck that actually HOLDS a proxied card, and `deck_proxies` is empty on a freshly seeded `local-dev` — so a sheet taken there reaches all four surfaces and photographs no mark on any of them, which reads as coverage while proving nothing. Mark a card in the app first. The `deck-card-view` row was verified reaching its surface at both widths on 2026-09-15; the MARK on it is unphotographed until a deck has one.

shares.note: Each view renders it as-is — no wrapper between them — so the check is asked of the file each row already names.

/decks/[id]/changes — a PENDING printed add, marked not billed
